description: Search the EscortFox directory of independent escorts, agencies and venues in one place. Returns up to 20 listing summaries per page: name, location, age, starting rate, verification status, incall/outcall, venue type, a short teaser and the listing's escortfox.com link. Summaries have no contact details or photos: always give the user each listing's link, where both are shown. "escort" and "venue" searches need country + city (find them with list_countries and list_cities); "agency" searches need country only. Only pages 0-4 (100 results) exist — narrow the search with district, service or verified instead of paging further.

city.description: City slug from list_cities (e.g. "berlin"). Required for escort and venue searches; not allowed for agency searches.

country.description: Required. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "DE"), or a city's region code where the site splits a country by state (e.g. "US-CA"). Get valid values from list_countries / list_cities.

district.description: Optional district slug from list_districts (escort and venue searches).

lang.description: Language of the teaser text and of the escortfox.com links. Default "en".

page.description: Zero-based results page, 0-4 (20 results each). Default 0.

service.description: Optional service slug from list_services (escort searches only).

verified.description: true = only escorts whose photos and phone are verified (escort searches only).

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
